NONE: A2 used to describe something that has no water or other liquid in, on, or around it
乾的，乾燥的
› If a river or other area of water runs dry, the water gradually disappears from it.
（河流等）乾涸，乾枯
C1 Dry hair or skin does not have enough of the natural oils that make it soft and smooth.
（頭髮或皮膚）乾燥的，乾性的
› UK Dry bread is plain, without butter, jam, etc.
（麵包）無奶油（或果醬）的
C2 disapproving If a book, talk, subject, etc. is dry, it is not interesting.
枯燥乏味的，乾巴巴的
› without alcoholic drinks
無酒精飲料的
C1 If wine or other alcoholic drinks are dry, they do not taste sweet.
（葡萄酒等酒精飲料）無甜味的，乾的
› approving Dry humour is very funny in a way that is clever and not obvious.
不形於色的，不露聲色的
› a place where the conditions are not wet, especially when compared to somewhere where the conditions are wet
乾爽的地方，乾燥的地方
A2 to become dry, or to make something become dry
（使）變乾，（使）乾燥；晾乾，烘乾
› to dry plates, knives, forks, etc. after they have been washed
擦乾餐具

example: I hung his wet trousers on the radiator, but they're not dry yet.
我把他的濕褲子掛在散熱器上了，但現在還沒乾呢。
These plants grow well in dry soil/a dry climate.
這些植物適宜在乾旱的土壤裡／氣候條件下生長。
This cake's a bit dry - I think I left it in the oven for too long.
這個蛋糕有點乾——估計是給我烤過頭了。
By this time all the wells had run dry.
到這個時候所有的井都已經乾枯了。
a shampoo for dry hair
適用於乾性髮質的洗髮水
All I was offered was a piece of dry bread and an apple!
他們只給了我一塊沒有奶油的麵包和一個蘋果。
a dry wedding
不喝酒的婚禮
a dry bar
無酒精酒吧
a dry state (= a place that does not allow alcohol)
禁酒的州
On the whole, I like dry wine better than sweet.
總的來講，我更喜歡乾葡萄酒，不喜歡甜葡萄酒。
a dry sense of humour
不露聲色的幽默感
a dry wit
不形於色的詼諧
You're soaked - come into the dry.
你都濕透了——快到乾的地方來。
Will this paint dry by tomorrow?
明天油漆會乾嗎？
Hang the clothes up to dry.
把衣服掛起來晾乾。
The fruit is dried in the sun.
水果在陽光照射下變得乾巴巴的。

NONE: › to make someone or something dry, or to become dry, especially on the surface
（使）變乾；弄乾（尤指表面）

example: I dried myself off and got dressed.
我擦乾身體穿上衣服。

NONE: › to make something dry, or to become dry
（使）變乾，（使）乾透

example: If you don't keep food covered, it dries out.
如果不把食物蓋好，就會變乾。

NONE: › an area of water that can be emptied and used for repairing ships
乾船塢
› food, such as coffee and flour, that is solid and dry
乾貨（如咖啡、麵粉等）
› US old-fashioned UK drapery cloth, pins, thread, etc. used for sewing
紡織品；縫紉用品
› frozen carbon dioxide, used for keeping things very cold and for producing a gas that looks like smoke in musical and theatre performances
乾冰，固態二氧化碳
› land and not sea or water
陸地

example: We sailed for three days before we saw dry land.
我們航行了三天才看到陸地。

NONE: › Someone who dries out stops being dependent on (= unable to stop drinking) alcohol.
戒酒

example: He went to a clinic in Arizona to dry out.
他到亞利桑那州的一個診所接受戒酒治療。

NONE: › a disease caused by a fungus that destroys wood in houses, boats, etc.
（木材的）乾腐病
› a practice of a particular activity or performance
試運行；演習；排練

example: The day before the trial, the lawyers tried a dry run of the closing arguments.
審判的前一天，律師們排練了一次最後陳詞。

NONE: › a structure consisting of a slope covered with plastic or some other material on which people can ski in areas where there is no snow
（練習用）人造滑雪斜坡
› to dry plates, cups, etc. with a cloth after they have been washed
擦乾（食具）
› If a river, lake, etc. dries up, the water in it disappears.
（河流、湖泊等）乾涸
C2 If a supply of something dries up, it ends.
（供給品）中斷

example: His main source of work had dried up, leaving him short of money.
他的主要訂單來源中斷了，造成他資金短缺。

NONE: › to stop crying
別哭了

example: Come on, Rosie, dry your eyes and we'll go and find Daddy.
好了，羅西，別哭了，我們找爸爸去。

NONE: › to clean clothes with chemicals, not water
乾洗

example: This dress has to be dry-cleaned.
這條裙子必須乾洗。

NONE: › a shop where clothes are cleaned with chemicals
乾洗店
› If someone is dry-eyed, that person is not crying, especially in a situation in which you might expect them to be crying.
不流淚的；心腸硬的，不易被打動的

example: She accused me of being unfeeling because I left the cinema dry-eyed.
離開電影院時我沒哭，於是她便說我心腸太硬。

NONE: › a machine that dries things
烘乾機
› UK also tumble dryer a machine that dries wet clothes by turning them in hot air
滾筒式烘乾機

example: a hair dryer
（吹乾頭髮用的）吹風機
a grain dryer
糧食烘乾機
Put those damp clothes in the (tumble) dryer.
把那些濕衣服放到（滾筒式）烘乾機裡去。
Compare
spin-dryer

NONE: › a wall made with stones that fit together firmly without being stuck together with mortar
（未用灰泥而壘起的）乾砌石牆
› material consisting of two sheets of heavy paper with a layer of plaster between them, used to make walls and ceilings before putting on a top layer of plaster
（建築用）灰泥板，紙面石膏板
